title: Repair build order, exports and asset relocation

commands.invocation: node renderers/<type>/render-<type>.mjs for all five families
commands.result: architecture 821349, workflow 817897, sequence 812111, dataflow 819318, lifecycle 808440 bytes

acceptanceResults.criterion: Build and packed-package smoke tests work from a clean directory.
acceptanceResults.evidence: All five renderers run with cwd set to a temporary directory whose name contains spaces, outside the repository, producing valid SVG-bearing HTML. Asset resolution derives from import.meta.url; process.cwd() appears nowhere in the resolver's executable code.

acceptanceResults.criterion: CLI, Studio and producer resolve the same owned diagram engine.
acceptanceResults.evidence: A single owned @hyperframes/diagram-engine is registered and resolves the viewer template through the @hyperframes/diagram-viewer package export. Studio and producer do not call the engine yet - that wiring is AFM-027 (compileDiagram API), AFM-051 (API) and AFM-063 (Studio). What is verified now is that exactly one engine exists to resolve, with no duplicate template copy to drift from.

acceptanceResults.criterion: Files required only at runtime are present in the package artifact.
acceptanceResults.evidence: The engine's packed files list includes renderers, schemas, examples, brand-marks and src; the viewer's includes assets. Asserted by test, since omitting a runtime-only directory produces a package that resolves paths which do not exist.

findings.summary: The engine/viewer split broke Archify's asset resolution.
findings.detail: cli.mjs resolved its template as path.resolve(rendererDir, '../..') joined with assets/template.html, assuming the renderers still sat below a skill root that also held assets/. The import ledger routed archify/assets/template.html to packages/diagram-viewer/, so every renderer failed with ENOENT. This was the first hard blocker on the render path.
findings.consequence: Added packages/diagram-engine/src/resolveAssets.mjs: all asset lookup derives from import.meta.url or package resolution, never from cwd or an assumed parent layout. The viewer template resolves through the @hyperframes/diagram-viewer/template export, with a workspace-sibling fallback for an unlinked source checkout. Deliberately not path-patched: contract C02 keeps the HTML shell out of the engine entirely, and AFM-027 removes the engine's need for a template at all.

findings.summary: The engine's binary name would have collided with a globally installed upstream CLI.
findings.detail: The inherited manifest declared bin 'archify'. docs/EXECUTION_RULES.md forbids relying on a globally installed upstream CLI, and an identically named bin makes the two indistinguishable on PATH.

notPerformed: No build step was added for the engine: it is plain .mjs executed directly, and contract C11 says to keep .mjs where practical until a separately tested refactor provides value.
The five renderers remain CLI entry points. The side-effect-free compileDiagram(request) to DiagramArtifact boundary is AFM-027.
